set.body:
Owner decision 2026-09-22: the film compiler (video -> narrative StoryModel with anchored entities, situations and causal structure) moves from 1.0 to 1.1 -- "but we don't want to forget about it". 1.0 ships film-capable public types (D1A-types/D1B signatures, landed) plus video-as-timeline mapping (annotation- and caption-assisted recall->video mapping, and the video-only timed-source package). The compiler is additive over those types, so 1.1 does not break the 1.0 API.

This container groups the 1.1 film lane (rel children): D1A-film, D1B end-to-end proofs, F1-F6 slices, E0 recall-map over a compiled film source, and V1 movie P/F codec/lowering. Its input is the same annotation/caption timed-source records the 1.0 mapper consumes (N2 video-only package), so no rework is implied.

Exit: all children closed or explicitly re-scoped; a 1.1 release note naming what the compiled-film path adds (narrative-level recall analysis of films). Priority stays P2 so the lane remains visible in the ready queue after the 1.0 critical path.
set.title: [1.1] Film compiler: video to narrative StoryModel (moved from 1.0 by owner decision)
